llm.summary: The skill appears to support TikTok/Kalodata product lookups, but it uses sensitive environment-derived headers, an overridable network gateway, mandatory local response persistence, and an unrelated feedback endpoint that users should review before installing.

dimensions.detail: The scripts reportedly send API/session metadata from environment variables to a POST endpoint whose base URL can be overridden by LINKFOX_TOOL_GATEWAY, creating overbroad routing risk for credentials and execution metadata.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No VirusTotal signal was supplied and no malicious install behavior was provided; however, scanner context reports no explicit permission declarations for network, environment-variable access, or local file writes.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger wording appears broad enough to catch generic product price or sales questions, which could invoke a networked analytics workflow when the user did not clearly ask for TikTok/Kalodata data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill reportedly requires writing full API responses to predictable files in the working directory on every run, without a clear opt-in or minimization step.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core product search/detail API calls fit the stated analytics purpose, but the documented feedback submission endpoint is outside the apparent purpose of retrieving product rankings and details.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the destination host, required environment variables, and saved output files before installing. Use this only in a workspace where writing product-query results to disk is acceptable, and avoid setting LINKFOX_TOOL_GATEWAY unless you trust the target endpoint to receive authorization and session metadata.
llm.findings:
[TT3] unexpected: Network calls with an API key are expected for this skill, but forwarding environment-derived authorization/session headers to an environment-overridable gateway is not sufficiently scoped for that purpose.
[LP3] unexpected: Network access, environment-variable use, and file writes may be needed, but the reported lack of declared permissions weakens user transparency.
[SDI-1] unexpected: A feedback submission endpoint is not clearly necessary for TikTok product ranking or detail retrieval.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The same feedback path could carry user-provided content outside the core analytics workflow if invoked.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Broad activation for generic product price or sales language risks unintended invocation beyond the stated TikTok/Kalodata use case.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Persisting full responses by default is disproportionate unless clearly disclosed, minimized, and user-controlled.
